reason: Aborts the human approval prompt when APPROVAL_MS ends. The timer does not ask again and does not hide a failed read.
pregate ci wait polls provider status on the interval the operator set, until the deadline. A pending check is the state being observed. The delay does not retry a failed request.
Kills curl if it is still running after 25 seconds. curl already has --max-time 20. The timer does not send the request again.
Ends the stdin read at STDIN_DEADLINE_MS when EOF does not arrive. The hook then fails closed. The timer does not read stdin again.
Windows can refuse a rename or delete while an on-access scanner holds the new file. The pause waits for that handle, and a lock that outlasts waitMs still throws. Any other error is not retried.
A person who types a choice outside the menu is asked at most three times, then the review cancels. The bound is the conversation. It does not retry a failed operation.
Aborts an unanswered terminal question when APPROVAL_MS ends. The timer does not ask again and does not hide a failed read.
A person who names a pack that is not in the list is asked at most three times, then the review cancels. The bound is the conversation. It does not retry a failed operation.
After codex app-server exits, the last stderr line is read, and the read gives up after 2 seconds if the stream never ends. The RPC is not sent again.
The supervisor clock checks the engine deadline every 20 milliseconds and kills the child when it expires. The interval does not spawn the engine again.
A non-blocking pipe returns EAGAIN or EWOULDBLOCK when the reader is behind. The 1 millisecond pause yields until the pipe accepts the rest of the bytes. Any other error still throws.
